program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (19.0, 14.0, 24.0),     # diff pair efficiency (weak inversion -> big area)
    "L1":    (4.0, 2.0, 6.0),        # diff pair L (area for low 1/f)
    "Itail": (50e-6, 25e-6, 100e-6),
    "gmid3": (6.5, 5.0, 9.0),        # PMOS load / M6 (matched)
    "Lp":    (1.5, 0.8, 3.0),
    "Cc":    (3e-12, 1.5e-12, 5e-12),
    "p2k":   (4.0, 2.5, 7.0),        # gm6 = p2k*gm1*CL/Cc
    "rzk":   (1.3, 0.8, 3.0),        # Rz = rzk/gm6
    "gmidb": (11.0, 8.0, 15.0),      # NMOS bias mirrors (low Vdsat for tail)
    "Lb":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    Cc = p["Cc"]
    It = p["Itail"]
    I1 = It / 2

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.45, vsb=0.3)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=1.0)
    gm1 = m1.gm
    gm6_t = p["p2k"] * gm1 * CL / Cc
    I6 = gm6_t / p["gmid3"]
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["Lp"], I6, vds=0.9)
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], It, vds=0.3)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], I6, vds=0.9)
    Rz = p["rzk"] / m6.gm

    def fing(op, wmax=20.0):
        return max(1, int(math.ceil(op.W / wmax)))

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1, m=fing(m1))
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1, m=fing(m1))
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3, m=fing(m3))
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3, m=fing(m3))
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5, m=fing(m5))
    n.dev("M8", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8, m=fing(m8))
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m6, m=fing(m6))
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7, m=fing(m7))
    n.R("Rz", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("Cc", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    Cout1 = m6.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    p2 = m6.gm / (2 * PI * (CL + Cout1 * (1 + CL / Cc)))
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd))
    wz = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / m6.gm))
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir)) \
         + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / wz)) * 0.5 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * pmir)))
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300.15
    vn_th = math.sqrt(4 * kT * (2.0 / 3.0) * 2 / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    # flicker calibrated on iter-1 sim: 3.615e-7 V/rtHz with n-pair gmid 15, L 1, 18.7 uA
    ref = lut.size("n", 15.0, 1.0, 18.7e-6, vds=0.45, vsb=0.3)
    A0 = ref.W * ref.L
    vn_f = 3.615e-7 * math.sqrt(A0 / (m1.W * m1.L))
    noise_1k = math.sqrt(vn_f ** 2 + vn_th ** 2)
    power = spec.get("vdd", 1.8) * (iref + It + I6)
    slew = min(It / Cc, I6 / (CL + Cc))
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "noise_1k": noise_1k, "slew": slew}
